title: Data retention - legacy
text: Deleted customer content may remain in backups for up to 90 days. Application logs are retained for 180 days.

title: Data retention
text: Deleted customer content remains in recoverable backups for up to 30 days. Application logs are retained for 90 days. Enterprise customers may request shorter log retention.

title: SSO and MFA
text: Enterprise plans support SAML 2.0 single sign-on. Administrators can require MFA for all workspace members. SCIM provisioning is available on Enterprise.

title: Data residency
text: EU data residency is available for Enterprise workspaces. Primary customer content can be stored in Frankfurt. Support metadata may be processed globally.

title: Service level agreement
text: The Enterprise SLA provides 99.95% monthly uptime. Service credits require a claim within 30 days after the affected month.

title: Support plans
text: Business support has a target first response within 8 business hours. Enterprise priority support targets a first response within 1 hour for Severity 1 incidents.

title: API rate limits
text: The standard API limit is 600 requests per minute per workspace. Enterprise customers can request higher limits subject to review.

title: Audit logs
text: Enterprise audit logs record authentication, role changes, exports, and administrative settings changes. Audit logs are retained for 365 days.

title: Billing and cancellation
text: Monthly subscriptions can be cancelled at any time and remain active until the end of the billing period. Annual contracts are non-refundable unless the order form states otherwise.

title: Encryption
text: Customer content is encrypted in transit using TLS 1.2 or later and encrypted at rest using AES-256.

title: Backups and recovery
text: Production databases are backed up daily. Recovery procedures are tested quarterly. Point-in-time recovery is available for the previous 7 days.

title: Plans and pricing
text: The Team plan costs $29 per user per month when billed monthly. Enterprise pricing is custom and depends on deployment and support requirements.
